Cloze CCS21-03aedbd1 01_Preliminary_Rules_01_to_10
Rule 8 proceedings authorities after GSR 770(E) 07.10.2022 — 1President, 2Secretary, 3CAG + appeal 48(6A) to President?
Rule 8 proceedings authorities after GSR 770(E) 07.10.2022 — President, Secretary, CAG + appeal 8(6A) to President?
Rule: Amended Rule 8(1) per GSR 770(E) 07.10.2022:

• (a) President for posts appointed by President;

• (b) Secretary of Administrative Ministry/Department for posts appointed by subordinate authority;

• (c) CAG for Indian Audit & Accounts Department.

UPSC consultation ONLY when President is competent authority (Rule 8(1) proviso).

New Rule 8(6A): Appeal against order of Secretary/CAG lies to President (30 days).

Also Expl-1(ii) of Rule 20 reversed: 'was not required to be refunded' → 'was to be refunded'.

Hinglish: President, Secretary, CAG — teen pradhikari; appeal President ko.

Ref: Rule 8(1)(a)(b)(c), 8(6A), 8(1) proviso; GSR 770(E) dt 07.10.2022; Rule 20 Expl-1(ii)

Female govt servant can nominate 1child/children over husband for family pension in case of 2marital discord — divorce petition / PWDVA / DPA / IPC case filed — which DoPPW amendment?
Female govt servant can nominate child/children over husband for family pension in case of marital discord — divorce petition / PWDVA / DPA / IPC case filed — which DoPPW amendment?
Rule: DoPPW OM No. 1/1(1)/2023-P&PW(E) dated 01.01.2024 amending Rule 50(8)(9) of CCS (Pension) Rules 2021 — progressive women empowerment amendment, notified via PIB 29.01.2024.

Conditions: Female Govt servant/pensioner must have divorce proceedings pending in competent court, OR case filed against husband under Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act (PWDVA) 2005, OR Dowry Prohibition Act (DPA) 1961, OR Indian Penal Code (IPC) (now BNS).

Procedure: Written request to Head of Office stating that in event of her death during pendency of proceedings, family pension be granted to eligible child/children in precedence to spouse.

Hinglish: Mahila karmchari pati se vivaad me bachchon ko pension ka haq de sakti hai — likhit arzi HoO ko.

Ref: Rule 50(8)(9) as amended by DoPPW OM 01.01.2024; PIB PRID 2000373 dt 29.01.2024; GSR 770(E) context
CCS_PensionRule_50Female_NominationAmendment_2024CCS_Pension::Rule_50Priority::Critical
Basic CCS21-0e51be52 05_Family_Pension_DR_Rules_50_to_52
Female servant dies during divorce/PWDVA/DPA/IPC proceedings after requesting child-precedence — disbursement order?
Female servant dies during divorce/PWDVA/DPA/IPC proceedings after requesting child-precedence — disbursement order?
Rule: Per 2024 amendment to Rule 50(8)(9):

(i) If survived by widower with NO eligible child → family pension to widower;

(ii) If widower is guardian of minor child or child with mental disability → pension to widower as guardian till child attains majority;

(iii) Once child attains majority and remains eligible → directly to child;

(iv) If major eligible child exists at time of death → directly to child in precedence to widower;

(v) If child ceases to be eligible → to other eligible children, if any;

(vi) If no eligible child → to widower till death/remarriage.

Hinglish: Baccha nabaligh to pati guardian ke roop me; baligh to seedha bacche ko; baccha na ho to pati ko.

Ref: Rule 50(8)(9) amended 01.01.2024; DoPPW clarification 29.01.2024

Rule: FALSE — Amendment is ONLY for female Govt servant/female pensioner, NO consent of husband required; male servants continue under old spouse-first rule. CPAO Special Seal Authority timeline — 121 days for 2superannuation retirement vs 310 days for 4death/family pension — source?
CPAO Special Seal Authority timeline — 21 days for superannuation retirement vs 10 days for death/family pension — source?
Rule: DoPPW OM 09.03.2021 + Rule 80(3) retirement track + Rule 76(8)(b) death track + Timeline OM 12.11.2024:

• Superannuation: AO → CPAO within 2 months of receipt of pension papers; CPAO issues Special Seal within 21 days of receipt of PPO (DoPPW timeline).

• Death/Family Pension: AO → CPAO within 1 month of receipt of family pension case; CPAO issues Special Seal within 10 days; PDA disburses within 15 days.

• TRAP: Retirement 21d, Death 10d — do not interchange.

Hinglish: Retirement me 21 din, mrityu me 10 din — CPAO ka seal.

Ref: Rule 80(2)(3)(4); Rule 76(8); DoPPW OM 3(6)/2021-P&PW(H)-7083 dt 09.03.2021; DoPPW Timeline OM dt 12.11.2024
